title: The Queen Has Two Jobs
setup: Black's queen on b7 is defending the rook on c8 and the knight on b4 at the same time.
hint: One black piece is doing two jobs. Give it something it cannot refuse and see which job it drops.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Rxc8+}} is check, so {{Qxc8}} is forced — and the queen leaves the b-file. {{Bxb4}} then wins the knight. Rook traded for rook first, so pulling the defender away costs nothing. Look for a piece with two duties before you look for a combination.
